snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Nordic Horizons Video Trailer
snippet.description:
The official video trailer for the upcoming Nordic Horizons DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2 just arrived!

It won't be long until you are driving through breathtaking fjords and towering mountains that stretch all the way to the Arctic Ocean, surrounded by stunning landscapes brimming with nature. Along the way, you'll pass vibrant cities, iconic bridges, underwater tunnels, narrow roads, charming coastal villages, and smaller towns with classic Nordic architecture.

Now available on Steam:  👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2780810/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Nordic_Horizons/#game_area_purchase
